title: Accounts Memorandum: Settlement Terms by Service, Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services

# Accounts Memorandum: Settlement Terms by Service

For each service of Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services, the stage at which the fee falls due, the deposit taken at intake, whether identification is checked at pickup, the holding period after which storage is charged, the storage charge per started month, the cancellation window and the cancellation charge are as follows. Money figures are in USD.

| Service | Fee falls due | Deposit taken at intake, per cent of the quoted fee | Identification checked before hand-back | Holding period before storage is charged, calendar days | Storage per started month | Cancellation window, calendar days | Cancellation charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | At intake | 0 | Yes | 14 | 15 | 1 | 0 |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | On issue | 0 | Yes | 30 | 20 | 3 | 45 |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | On issue | 0 | Yes | 30 | 20 | 3 | 60 |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | On delivery | 25 | Yes | 45 | 35 | 5 | 125 |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | At intake | 50 | Yes | 30 | 40 | 2 | 195 |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | On delivery | 40 | Yes | 60 | 95 | 7 | 400 |

## Notes

1. **Fee falls due** names the stage at which the fee is payable: at intake, on issue of the report, or on delivery of the report and the piece.
2. **Deposit** is the share of the quoted fee taken at intake, as a percentage; three services take no deposit.
3. **Identification checked** records whether identification is checked before the piece and the report are handed back; the column reads Yes at every service.
4. **Holding period** is the number of calendar days a finished engagement is held before storage is charged; **storage** is the charge per started month after that period.
5. **Cancellation window** is the number of calendar days after the engagement is taken within which it may be cancelled without charge; **cancellation charge** is the charge for cancelling after that window.

## Hypothetical reading of the deposit column

On a Certified Gemological Laboratory Report quoted at a hypothetical 1000, the deposit taken at intake is 50 per cent of that quote, which is 500. On an Estate and Probate Appraisal quoted at the same hypothetical 1000, the deposit is 25 per cent, which is 250. On an Insurance Replacement Appraisal no deposit is taken, whatever the quote.
